listing.name: Library of Ruina Portrait Pack
listing.summary: This mod adds portraits of most characters from the game Library of Ruina. Integrating some of them into the some of the vanilla factions.
listing.aiSummary: Adds portraits of characters from the game Library of Ruina to Starsector.

description:
Portrait Pack

This is a portrait pack containing all of your beloved (and hated) characters from the hit game

among us

Library of Ruina. Except all of the characters I deemed to be *too* out of place for starsector (mostly E.G.O. and distortions), they are in a separate download (below the main one) and are only added to the player faction. If I missed anyone, please scream at me.

DOWNLOAD
